_notes.name: The first name in the greeting, like "Good morning, Sam". Up to 40 characters.
_notes.blockLengths: One to five block lengths in minutes, offered as quick picks. The first is the default.
_notes.labels: Up to six one-word things the person focuses on, offered as quick picks beside free text.
_notes.dayStart: The hour the day strip starts, 0 to 23.
_notes.dayEnd: The hour the day strip ends, 1 to 24, at least four hours after dayStart.
_notes.chime: "soft" plays a short two-note chime when a block ends; "off" stays silent.
_notes.theme: "dusk" (indigo and ember, light text), "dawn" (cream and ink), "mono" (black with one accent), or "auto" (dawn on a light device, dusk on a dark one).
_notes.sample: true fills a first visit with a sample week and a block in its last seconds; false starts empty. Leave it out for a real start.
